name: tabward-workspace
description: Local browser control for AI agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tabward/protocol && npm run build -w @tabward/mcp
scripts.check: npm run check -w @tabward/protocol && npm run check -w @tabward/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tabward/protocol && npm run test -w @tabward/mcp && npm run test -w @tabward/test-harness
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run pack:extension && npm run audit:release
